note_en: 被称为 and 叫做 both mean "to be called," but they differ in register. The text opens with the everyday 叫做 (一个没有尽头的循环，叫做轮回), then switches to the more formal, written 被称为 (这种修行方法被称为念佛) and 合称为 "known collectively as" (合称为净土三经). In essay-style Chinese, 称为 phrases are the standard way to introduce a technical term.
